title: Alias Metric2 Monthly Rollup
dataSources: StockX market prices (`stockx:price`), GOAT listings (`goat:listing`), Alias sales (`alias:sale`), sneaker rotation logs (`sneaker:rotation`), and deadstock age checks (`deadstock:age`).
app: StockX price alerts, GOAT listing exports, Alias seller settlement logs, sneaker rotation wear trackers, and deadstock age audits ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=alias:metric2
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as events, sum(value) as total_value by _time
| sort _time
description: Summarises monthly event volume and total value for alias metric2 (2) data.
value: Monthly rollups smooth daily noise and show seasonal shifts in personal activity.
implementation: Aggregate alias metric2 (2) events monthly and chart count plus total value.
visualization: Column chart of monthly events with total value overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It predicts how your alias metric2 (2) activity added up each month instead of day by day.
